title: ID lookup pure projection + rank helper
description: `buildViewIndex(model)` projects a BuiltTreeModel into one row per PRD/REQ/US/TAD/TAC/ADR/BS/FBS/TS plus one row per AC under each US, each `{ id, kind, title, snippet, parent, tab }`; `snippet` is the kind-specific prose field whitespace-collapsed and capped at 110 chars; `tab` is the viewer tab that owns the id. `serialiseViewIndex(model)` returns the exact JSON string the server serves (so Content-Length matches). `rankLookupRows(query, rows)` implements the design doc section 6 ranking: single-char id-only, otherwise id first (exact / prefix / contains), then every word must match title or snippet, title weighted above snippet, stable on ties by id, 20-result cap. This is the pure projection the server renders into `./index.json` on every rewalk (AC-205-1 to AC-205-3).
